title: FlyDubai co-pilot used crash ax to attempt ‘terrorist act,’ UAE says
summary_full: The co-pilot of FlyDubai Flight 1073 used a crash ax in his attack, UAE officials said. An Israeli official identified him as Hammam al-Hamami, an Omani national.
